components.name: Pressure cylinder
components.description: Main cylinder with rounded shoulders and a protective base boot. Internal condition is not modelled.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Contains the extinguishing agent under pressure

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: External condition: corrosion, dents, deformation, damage

specs.label: Capacity / service pressure
specs.value: Unknown: manufacturer-dependent

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Internal condition cannot be determined from a photograph

components.name: Valve assembly
components.description: Valve head on the cylinder neck with the hose outlet and gauge port.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Controls discharge when the lever is squeezed

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Visible damage, corrosion or missing parts

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Internal valve function cannot be verified visually

components.name: Carrying handle
components.description: Fixed lower handle used to carry the extinguisher.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Carrying grip, below the operating lever

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Not bent, cracked or loose

components.name: Operating lever
components.description: Upper lever that opens the valve when squeezed (blocked by the safety pin).

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Actuates the valve

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Not bent or damaged; not partially depressed

components.name: Safety pin
components.description: Pin through the valve head that prevents accidental lever operation.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Locks the lever until pulled

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Pin present and fully inserted

components.name: Tamper seal
components.description: Breakable seal through the pin ring showing whether the pin was pulled.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Indicates possible use or tampering

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Seal present and unbroken

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Only judge 'intact' if the photo clearly shows it

components.name: Pressure gauge
components.description: Gauge on the valve front showing a visual pressure indication on stored-pressure designs.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Visual indication of pressure status on compatible stored-pressure designs

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Gauge present, visible and legible enough for human review

specs.label: Required evidence
specs.value: Close-up photograph of the gauge face

specs.label: Dial ranges
specs.value: Unknown: manufacturer-dependent (the model's dial is illustrative)

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: A photo cannot independently establish the extinguisher's operational condition

components.name: Discharge hose
components.description: Flexible hose from the valve outlet to the nozzle.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Carries agent from the valve to the nozzle

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: No cracks, cuts or disconnection

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Internal blockage cannot be verified from photographs

components.name: Discharge nozzle
components.description: Nozzle at the end of the hose.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Directs the discharge

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Present, undamaged, opening visibly unobstructed

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Performance and internal blockage cannot be verified visually

components.name: Operating instructions label
components.description: Wrap-around label with operating instructions. The model's label is marked as a demonstration label.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Operating instructions and product information

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Present, legible, not damaged or obscured

specs.label: Ratings on the label
specs.value: Unknown: manufacturer-dependent

components.name: Inspection tag
components.description: Inspection or maintenance record tag hanging from the neck, if present.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Records inspection or maintenance entries

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Present and legible; document visible dates as-is

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: A tag alone does not establish regulatory compliance

components.name: Mounting bracket
components.material: Dark metal wall bracket with strap (illustrative)
components.description: Wall bracket with strap and hook (included in this configuration).

specs.label: Function
specs.value: Holds the extinguisher in its mounted position

specs.label: Inspection objective
specs.value: Mounted/positioned, bracket undamaged, no obvious obstruction

specs.label: Limitation
specs.value: Mounting height or accessibility compliance needs measurement and the applicable rules
